verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branching that creates separate environments spun off from the main project, so users can test schemas, configurations and features without affecting production. It also offers isolated preview environments per pull request and a local CLI stack (`supabase init` / `supabase start`) whose changes are captured in migration files. A runtime probe confirms the CLI runs without an account, and older community complaints about doing migrations live in prod predate the preview-database work the CEO described, so they don't contradict branching. Missing for 10: explicit docs on pointing the MCP server or agents at a branch or local stack rather than production, and independent hands-on corroboration that branching works as claimed.
